sentences.text: [slightly amused] Sweden's most famous strongman was hired to hold a baby.
Tamil Nadu just gave new dads fifteen days off.
Sweden did it first, in nineteen seventy-four, and almost no dad took it.
Staying home with a baby made you look soft.
So the government put a weightlifter called Hoa-Hoa on a poster, cradling a baby.
[matter-of-fact] The baby wasn't even his, and Hoa-Hoa never took a day off himself.
So Sweden saved a month just for dads, and if he skipped it, the family lost it.
Now Swedish dads take a third of all the leave, and the strongman calls those forced months undemocratic.
